label: D2 lowered by recent non-reward, raised by a1 choice; GO tracks last choice
terms: (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_state == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D2) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (tv("reward", -3) == 0)
explanation: Raw GRU candidate n of unit 43. D1 is pinned near -0.99 (no structure). At GO it is higher after an a2 choice on the last trial (+0.11) and lower after a rewarded a1 trial (-0.18). Most of the variance is at D2: it drops after an unrewarded last trial (-0.29), and further for each earlier unrewarded trial (2 back -0.19, 3 back -0.08), so a run of losses drives it strongly negative; it is higher after a rewarded trip to S1 (+0.22), higher when the current choice is a1 (+0.31) and somewhat lower when S1 is reached (-0.10). All terms are observed at their step (no future/hidden/model variables). Dev R^2 beyond timing 0.757; profile ceilings: all 0.78, all observed 0.74.

issues: Minor: the label says 'GO tracks last choice', but GO also depends on the last reward. Lowering is specific to rewarded a1 (weight -0.18; prev-trial residuals a1 S1 r -0.18, a1 S2 r -0.20 vs a1 S1 u +0.03). The explanation states this; the label leaves it out.

Minor: the D2 term 'raised after rewarded S1' really is about the state reached, not the action taken. Swapping prev_state==1 for prev_action==1 drops test R^2 from 0.750 to 0.713, which supports the claim as worded.
The D2 state==1 term is small (-0.10). Dropping it costs about 0.017 test R^2 (0.733), so it is a real effect but secondary.

Remaining systematic errors are small: D2 after a1 S2 r is over-predicted by 0.10, D2 after a1 S2 u is under-predicted by 0.07, and GO after a2 S1 u/r is off by about 0.06. None is a large error class. Mean error by phase is about 0.

Test R^2 beyond timing of 0.750 matches dev (0.757) and is above the additive 'all observed' ceiling of 0.74. No future, hidden or model-output variables are used. My alternatives (prev_common at GO; splitting D2 non-reward by state) did not improve on it.
